points.text: Cyber incidents affected US Air Force Cloud One, prompted the UK benefits department to take services offline, and led SAP to secure its IT environment.
Canada’s Supreme Court upheld most of Quebec’s law barring public employees from wearing religious symbols at work; critics say it disproportionately affects religious minorities.
India’s Cabinet approved bills proposing a 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats, a freeze on state seat distribution until 2051, and one-third reservation for women.
Costa Rica denied entry to UN special rapporteur Francesca Albanese, citing alleged terrorism links; she denies the allegation, and a court barred her forced removal.
Fashion brands shifted roughly $250 million in orders from Bangladesh amid unrest and production disruptions, with most moving to India.
